integrity: The fixed-numerator formula follows from the recent arithmetic L-space criterion and Schubert inversion equivalence. The density theorem is proved from odd divisor sums, restricted totient sums, and a fixed-point bound; finite enumeration is only a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The classification is counted up to mirror and ordered by Schubert numerator, equivalently determinant. It does not count L-space surgery slopes and does not give crossing-number or volume density.
title: L-space-surgery two-bridge links have zero determinant density
